0022600162.text: The Orlando Magic (2-4, 9th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 1 game back) host the Washington Wizards (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) in Orlando's seventh game of the season, with the Magic 0-3 at home and coming off a loss. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (rest), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Washington is without Alex Sarr (knee soreness), Anthony Gill (back spasms), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, and Orlando won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-131 win in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
